behavior_scenarios.goal: Complete a bounded task through the production Agent execution path using a controlled real-model account.
acceptance: Result satisfies a written task-specific acceptance rubric
No unrequested source or user-data changes

behavior_scenarios.goal: Exercise tool selection, argument validation, denial, and retry behavior.
acceptance: Denied actions have no side effect
Retries do not repeat non-idempotent calls

behavior_scenarios.goal: Return a tool result larger than current output limits and inspect chunk retrieval and user-visible truncation.
Disconnect and reconnect the UI while an Agent run is active.

evidence.scope: Real Electron renderer and main process, local Brain, loopback Fake Provider, one injected SSE disconnect; does not cover a real Provider or prolonged pressure.

behavior_scenarios.scope_note: Two measured scopes pass: the original Electron chat reconnect case survives one injected network cut, and a repeated-cut focused run survives three cuts while preserving all seven streamed chunks and issuing only one Provider request. The full Electron/Brain E2E also crosses the bounded event window with 1,200 persisted text events and returns the authoritative snapshot. Long-duration sustained pressure and real remote-service behavior remain NOT RUN. A bounded-retry exhaustion probe then injected four cuts across one seven-chunk run (three client resumes); after the original Brain run completed, both renderer and Brain eventually reported succeeded. This is a short deterministic probe, not a long-running network outage test. The 1,200-event test also directly queried the isolated Agent SQLite ledger: it retained exactly 256 contiguous event rows ending at the terminal cursor; the event burst plus snapshot recovery took 15.8 seconds.

stress_evidence.result: PASS: cuts=3, resumed=3, same run/request, seven chunks preserved, one Provider request, no plugin side effects.

burst_evidence.result: PASS: 1,200 persisted text events exceed the 256-event window; SQLite retained exactly 256 contiguous rows ending at cursor 1204; old cursor returned authoritative terminal/content snapshot; 15.8s.

extended_burst_evidence.result: PASS: 5,000 persisted text events (~19.5x the 256-row retention window), cursor 5004, exactly 256 retained contiguous rows 4749–5004, full authoritative snapshot content; burst plus recovery 65.393s.
extended_burst_evidence.scope_note: Short deterministic local Electron/Brain/Fake Provider pressure only; does not measure long-duration memory/backpressure behavior or real network proxies.

retry_exhaustion_evidence.result: PASS: cuts=4, client resumes=3, same run reaches succeeded in both renderer and Brain.

round18_regression_evidence.result: PASS=12, FAIL=0, TIMEOUT=0, BLOCKED=0, NOT RUN=2; compared with prior regression run, all selected statuses unchanged and unselected cases remain NOT RUN.

final_clean_head_regression.result: PASS=12, FAIL=0, TIMEOUT=0, BLOCKED=0, NOT RUN=2; compared with Round 18, 12 selected cases unchanged and both unselected cases remain NOT RUN.

round22_clean_head_regression.result: PASS=12, FAIL=0, TIMEOUT=0, BLOCKED=0, NOT RUN=2; compared with Round 21, all selected cases unchanged and the two unselected cases remain NOT RUN.

behavior_scenarios.goal: Observe queued, running, terminal, and cancelled states across UI/Brain; cancel model generation and a long tool.
behavior_scenarios.scope_note: Renderer cancellation now has direct Electron/Brain evidence both before tool dispatch (while model generation is held and a late tool call is returned) and during an already-dispatched slow side-effecting plugin. Both runs become cancelled and no late tool/follow-up is dispatched; the composer unlocks. A focused upstream HTTP 503 case also proves the renderer's failed status/class matches the durable Brain failure, with no implicit retry or tool side effect. Renderer reload cancellation and bounded retry exhaustion state are separately measured. Full done/failure/cancel/timeout/reconnect/restart state matrix remains unverified.

ui_model_cancel_evidence.result: PASS: real renderer cancel during model generation; late tool-call response was not dispatched; Brain/UI terminal state cancelled.

ui_provider_failure_evidence.result: PASS: isolated Provider HTTP 503 produced Brain status failed and renderer status failed with matching service_error classification and a visible explanation; exactly one Provider request; no plugin side effect.
ui_provider_failure_evidence.scope_note: One deterministic local server-error injection only; real Provider auth/rate-limit behavior and the complete terminal-state matrix remain unverified.

behavior_scenarios.goal: Run a long context task with history and large tool results.
Restart/reconnect the application and resume a persisted session.
acceptance: Session identity and persisted state are accurate
Transient events are not claimed as persisted

behavior_scenarios.goal: Install, authorize, invoke, and remove a disposable test plugin.
Inject connect timeout, accepted-request response loss, stream disconnect, empty response and malformed event.
behavior_scenarios.scope_note: The accepted-request response-loss subcase now has isolated real-Electron/Fake-Provider evidence: the socket is destroyed after receipt, the run becomes connection_lost, and duplicate request_id does not replay it. Other scenarios remain NOT RUN as a whole: provider connect timeout, empty response and malformed-event coverage are incomplete.

behavior_scenarios.goal: Attempt unauthorized tool use and path traversal in a disposable workspace.
